preconditions.description: The number of people, including Greg, is between 1 and 50.
The boat's weight limit is between 1 and 5000 kilograms.

preconditions.expression: all(weight in [50, 100] for weight in weights)
preconditions.description: Each person's weight is either 50 or 100 kilograms.

postconditions.expression: return_value[0] == -1 if sum(weights) > k * (n - 1) else min_rides
postconditions.description: The first line of the output is -1 if transporting everyone to the other bank is impossible, otherwise it is the minimum number of rides required.

The second line of the output is 0 if transporting everyone to the other bank is impossible, otherwise it is the number of ways to transport everybody to the other side in the minimum number of rides modulo 1000000007.
